paper.title: NavHarness: Adaptive Goals for Agentic Vision-Language Navigation
paper.central_claim: NavHarness 用 Goal/Verify/Memory/Visuomotor 四智能体把自适应局部目标与目标特定完成验证耦合，并以已验证完成为边界做多模态上下文压缩；同基座下 R2R-CE/RxR-CE 零样本 SR 79.0%/82.5%（Codex CLI 74.0%/76.3%），压缩降低解码输入，真机 8 路线 x3 SR 83.3%、NE 1.51 m，并优于大规模训练的导航基础模型。
paper.claim_scope: 同基座对照在 Open-Nav 100 + RxR 100 episode；对训练模型的优越性为跨 cohort 参考比较（附录 B 自承非匹配排名）；真机 24 次试验。

evidence.quote: In real-world evaluation, NavHarness achieves 83.3% SR and 1.51 m navigation error across eight challenging routes, each evaluated three times.
evidence.support_explanation: 真机主张。

evidence.quote: With GPT-6-Astra as backbone, NavHarness achieves success rates (SR) of 79.0% on R2R-CE and 82.5% on RxR-CE, compared with 74.0% and 76.3%, respectively, for Codex CLI using the same backbone.
evidence.support_explanation: 同基座对 Codex CLI 的中心数字。

evidence.quote: locally plausible actions do not ensure consistency with the intended route
evidence.support_explanation: gap 1：局部合理动作不保证路线一致。

evidence.quote: accumulating interaction history increases inference overhead
evidence.support_explanation: gap 2：历史累积提高推理开销。

evidence.quote: The Goal Agent generates one local goal at a time, grounding it in the encountered situation
evidence.support_explanation: 自适应局部目标 + 验证问题。

evidence.quote: The Verify Agent assesses goal completion after each interaction step, separating outcome assessment from action generation
evidence.support_explanation: 目标特定完成验证（VLM 判断）。

evidence.quote: the Memory Agent compresses historical context at verified goal-completion boundaries
evidence.support_explanation: 以已验证完成为压缩边界。

evidence.quote: the inspected action interface does not impose an additional mechanical verification gate on STOP
evidence.support_explanation: STOP 无机械门控；验证只作为模型可参考的反馈。

evidence.quote: Codex CLI and NavHarness share backbones, episodes, and observation/action interfaces
evidence.support_explanation: 基线对照设计。

evidence.quote: We evaluate 100 episodes each on R2R-CE and RxR-CE
evidence.support_explanation: 分母：每基准 100 episodes。

evidence.quote: Codex CLI / GPT-6-Astra M Zero-shot 4.49 75.0 74.0 62.5 3.14 76.3 60.0 71.9 NavHarness / GPT-5.6-Sol M Zero-shot 4.60 69.5 67.0 47.9 7.28 34.0 25.0 47.0 NavHarness / GPT-6-Astra M Zero-shot 3.27 81.5 79.0 66.6 2.42 82.5 64.7 73.8
evidence.support_explanation: 主表控制比较行（含 OSR/SPL/nDTW）。

evidence.quote: This framework-level comparison does not isolate goal generation from verification.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认 Goal 与 Verify 未分离。

evidence.quote: Without compression, SR increases from 28%, 63%, and 74% to 32%, 67%, and 79%, respectively.
GPT-6-Astra saves 5.52% and 4.05%, with SR decreases of 2 and 1.5 points and an RxR-CE SPL decline from 64.7 to 58.3
evidence.support_explanation: 压缩收益依赖基座，且伴随 SR/SPL 下降。
RxR-CE/GPT-5.6-Sol：NavHarness(Off) 总 token 约为 Codex CLI 的 2.1 倍，预算未匹配。

evidence.quote: Baselines use the supplied aggregates; NavHarness uses eight routes with three trials each.
evidence.support_explanation: 真机基线来自“提供的汇总”，协议不明。

evidence.quote: NaVILA 20.83 3.91 AwareVLN 20.83 3.89 StreamVLN 25.00 3.78 JanusVLN 50.00 2.34 NavHarness 83.30 1.51
evidence.support_explanation: 真机对比行。

evidence.quote: These external results provide context rather than a single matched ranking.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认外部结果非匹配排名。

evidence.quote: Each route is tested three times with NavHarness, yielding 24 trials.
evidence.support_explanation: 真机试验数 24。

evidence.quote: reliance on remotely served closed-source models incurs substantial inference costs and communication latency, slowing the navigation loop
evidence.support_explanation: 作者局限：成本与延迟。

evidence.quote: Experimental results on VLN-CE, and Real-World show that the NavHarness outperforms navigation foundation models which trained on large-scale datasets in a zero-shot setting.
evidence.support_explanation: 贡献第三条：对训练模型的优越性主张。

evidence.quote: The sequences show observed behavior and do not independently establish the causal contribution of an individual framework component.
evidence.support_explanation: 定性案例不作因果证据；标注为解释性重构。

evidence.quote: The real-robot briefing identifies the physical platform and adds motion-uncertainty and clearance guidance rather than assuming exact simulator motion.
evidence.support_explanation: 真机提示有平台特定调整。

evidence.quote: Those text-task findings motivate careful context design without establishing a navigation failure mechanism.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认压缩动机未建立导航失败机制。
100 个 episode 却出现 62.6 的非整数 SR，暗示多次运行平均，运行数未说明。

evidence.quote: Both configurations include all recorded inference components, and Goal includes the Memory Agent’s compression overhead.
evidence.support_explanation: token 记账包含全部内部调用。

evidence.quote: Efficiency averages include successful and failed episodes with complete usage records and exclude incomplete records.
evidence.support_explanation: 效率均值排除不完整记录。

evidence.quote: Using monocular input in a zero-shot setting, GPT-6-Astra-based NavHarness exceeds Qwen-RobotNav by 6.9 and 6.0 SR points.
evidence.support_explanation: 与训练模型的跨 cohort 比较。
全文未报告 Verify Agent 判断相对环境真值/人工标注的准确率，也无误判分解；已查 Sec 3.3, 4.2-4.5, Appx C-D。

signatures.object: 导航 agent 的局部目标生成与进度判定回路（相对 Codex CLI 原生循环）
signatures.information: 指令 x、当前 RGB、历史 (压缩记忆+近期记录)；Verify Agent 看到执行记录与最新观测但不含正在生成的判断；模型不获得评测器的参考路径/成功标签/距离
signatures.operation: Goal Agent 产出 (g_k, q_k)；Visuomotor 执行动作批；Verify 回答 q_k 并给出继续/修订/推进建议；Eq.8 路由 Continue/UpdateGoal/Stop/Halt

signatures.conditions: 单目 RGB，前进0.25m/转15°/STOP，动作预算
signatures.feedback: 观测结果驱动的 VLM 验证文本；STOP 无机械门控
signatures.persistence: 仅 episode 内（goal 状态+记忆）
signatures.later_use: 同一 episode 后续目标生成/执行/验证
signatures.failure_boundary: Goal 与 Verify 未分离；验证准确率未测；STOP 不被验证强制

signatures.object: 多模态历史上下文（相对原生上下文管理与不压缩）
signatures.information: 在验证完成边界对已完成段做摘要：已走目标/地标/空间关系、验证结果、各验证点关键帧
signatures.operation: Memory Agent 用 m+ = M(x, m-, H_b, g_k, q_k, p_b) 替换已完成段
signatures.output: 压缩后的上下文，保留未完成状态
signatures.conditions: 仅在验证通过时压缩；修订未完成目标时保留细节
signatures.feedback: 验证完成作为触发信号
signatures.failure_boundary: 收益依赖基座；SR/SPL 小幅下降

gap.author_gap: 通用多模态 agent 的局部合理动作与路线一致性脱节、偏差沿长程累积；累积历史使推理输入膨胀，而粗暴截断会丢地标/纠正/未完成目标。
gap.checked_gap: 两条 gap 有来源（引用 Zhou et al. 2026 等）并与 token 数据一致；但文中未对基线失败做偏差归因诊断，且作者自承文本任务研究并未建立导航失败机制。路线偏离被复合的机理仅由结果间接支持。
